method: Genuine Chromium screenshots of a fresh production build. Before: direct item links. After: normal Shop/category/slot/item clicks. All73 items at600/1800/4100ms. Echo alone recaptured after final clipping correction. Gallery embeds JPEG copies of screenshots, not redrawn assets. Reviewer categories are subjective, not pixel-delta scores.

audit.name: Bare Head
audit.observation: Baseline character and text; no special power action expected.

audit.name: Gold Halo
audit.observation: Falling dots show the lighter fall. Character itself stays posed.

audit.name: Cyber Ears
audit.observation: Combo grace is shown by two bars; weak as a character animation.

audit.name: Viper Horns
audit.observation: Speed/width comparison uses bars, not a moving attack.

audit.name: Broken Oni
audit.observation: Health and score text change; the reward is readable but mostly static.

audit.name: Ninja Slits
audit.observation: Baseline eyes; minimal visual change is intentional.

audit.name: Cyber Visor
audit.observation: Small lights on visor change; easy to miss without enlargement.

audit.name: SSJ Blaze
audit.observation: Eye cuts change slightly. Refill benefit is described more than demonstrated.

audit.name: Paper Ninja
audit.observation: Base health is displayed. No special triggered power shown.

audit.name: Obsidian Stealth
audit.observation: Score bonus is text beside a static body. Needs an action example.

audit.name: Hologram Wire
audit.observation: Needle moves through the shell; phase hardware is visible but understated.

audit.name: Standard Heart
audit.observation: Base health and Edge values, intentionally not a proc animation.

audit.name: Time Crystal
audit.observation: Recovery bars move while the character stays static.

audit.name: Riot Reactor
audit.observation: Kill counters and Overdrive text change; action is mostly implied.

audit.name: Glass Cannon
audit.observation: Health tradeoff and doubled score appear as changing numbers.

audit.name: Ninja Ribbon
audit.observation: Cloth baseline, not an extra force or combat proc.

audit.name: Prism Wings
audit.observation: Wing pose/hardware changes after the first wall event; little motion.

audit.name: Ghost Scarf
audit.observation: Scarf brightens slightly. Longer cut duration is not obvious visually.

audit.name: White Razor
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Katana Ink
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Neon Laser
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Twilight Undercut
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.

audit.name: Cyber Tokyo
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.

audit.name: Blood Foundry
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.

audit.name: Cube Crown
audit.observation: Armor plates cross out; useful explanation, not a full attack scene.

audit.name: Samurai Crest
audit.observation: Wider cutting lane is a bar comparison, not a character sweep.

audit.name: Lightning Coil
audit.observation: A visible zigzag joins two enemies after a cut. Character remains posed.

audit.name: Danger Beacon
audit.observation: Warning brackets appear around the Fang; useful but small.

audit.name: Glitch X-Eyes
audit.observation: Eye conductors shift slightly; recovery benefit is mostly text.

audit.name: Smug Half-Lid
audit.observation: Eyes visibly turn gold; combo extension is still mainly explained in copy.

audit.name: Hypno Spiral
audit.observation: Eye spirals change; the affected enemy is absent from the main illustration.

audit.name: Sniper Dot
audit.observation: Armor plates cross out after the precise hit; fairly readable comparison.

audit.name: Prism Shell
audit.observation: Wall hardpoints change state; needles are brief and not resolved by these three frames.

audit.name: Bastion Iron
audit.observation: Guard latch visibly changes from ready to spent; no large impact animation.

audit.name: Lava Cracked
audit.observation: Combo bars/links change. Character motion does not show the benefit.

audit.name: Gold Foil
audit.observation: Score bonus remains prominent static text; no score event animation.

audit.name: Grav Core
audit.observation: An enemy moves toward the aim line, but only in a small diagram.

audit.name: Magnet Dynamo
audit.observation: Close-pass width benefit is another bar comparison.

audit.name: Echo Heart
audit.observation: A stationary blade appears after three kill counters; small action area.

audit.name: Viper Tails
audit.observation: Tail folds shift; steering preservation is not visually demonstrated.

audit.name: Anchor Chain
audit.observation: Chain and weight move slightly. Floor-kick strength remains textual.

audit.name: Mini Thrusters
audit.observation: Jets visibly switch on and off in the sampled sequence.

audit.name: Neon Spectrum
audit.observation: Small tail hardware/counter changes; earned Edge needs stronger action feedback.

audit.name: Glitch Tear
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Gold Confetti
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Comic Impact
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Pixel Shatter
audit.observation: Visible sweep and split target. Variants mostly share choreography with color/shape differences.

audit.name: Manga Paper
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.

audit.name: Synthwave Grid
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.

audit.name: Chamfer Frame
audit.observation: Armor shove contact and numbers are visible; the actor barely moves.

audit.name: Notched Frame
audit.observation: Vents open, recovery bars fill, then vents close. Mostly a comparison chart.

audit.name: Segmented Frame
audit.observation: Spring return is described with state and speed readouts, little displacement.

audit.name: Adaptive Dash
audit.observation: Launch changes character position. The held reference now retains its effect.

audit.name: Ink Dash
audit.observation: Launch is visible, but width advantage is still a bar comparison.

audit.name: Ember Dash
audit.observation: Fire-hit aftermath is visible, but tiny actors and dense timing text weaken it.

audit.name: Volt Dash
audit.observation: Accepted arc is visible, but tiny hero and speed/width charts dominate. Card motion and travel-dependent rear rails were repaired.

audit.name: Frost Dash
audit.observation: Frozen collar, thaw state and timer are visible. Still a dense miniature lesson.

audit.name: Tide Dash
audit.observation: Launch is visible. Recovery benefit remains a chart rather than a clear character event.

audit.name: Void Dash
audit.observation: Outer pull ring and smaller striking core visibly differ; text-heavy miniature scene.

audit.name: Echo Dash
audit.observation: Travel, old path and replay are visible. Late enemy now stays within panel. Scene is still dense at mobile size.

audit.name: Field Reticle
audit.observation: Aiming-origin reference, not an attack or target lock.

audit.name: Prism Pointer
audit.observation: Pointer expands slightly; extra cutting time is barely visible in the bars.

audit.name: Orbit Pointer
audit.observation: Pointer changes slightly and focus recovery bars fill.

audit.name: Crosshair Pointer
audit.observation: Pointer expands slightly; reduced aim cost is represented by bars.

audit.name: Field Radar
audit.observation: Map reference with no extra sensor upgrade; mostly static.

audit.name: Long-Range Array
audit.observation: Extra map contact/range appears; movement is not the selling point.

audit.name: Threat Array
audit.observation: Hazards appear as tiny dots/marks; range comparison remains chart-based.

audit.name: Oracle Array
audit.observation: Hazard and heading marks appear, but fine details are small.

audit.name: Field Trajectory
audit.observation: The short visible flight path grows across sampled frames.

audit.name: Vector Lens
audit.observation: A longer flight path visibly grows.

audit.name: Impact Lens
audit.observation: Path grows and a first-wall marker appears.

audit.name: Oracle Lens
audit.observation: Path grows with first-wall marker and a compact flight readout.

audit.name: Pro Void
audit.observation: Scenery visibly travels; this is a cosmetic tour, not new arena geometry.
